item.description: OTTAWA — The federal government is being accused of creating an uneven playing field in Canada's shipping industry, and critics claim the Prime Minister's Office is unwilling to rectify it.

item.title: Coroner says B.C. teen was forced into water by dingoes in Australia
item.description: BRISBANE — A young woman from British Columbia drowned when she was attacked by a pack of dingoes at a famed tourist destination in Australia, a coroner has determined.

item.description: TORONTO — Another suspect has been arrested and charged in the shooting death of a 15-year-old boy in Toronto.

item.title: Brazilian soccer player suspended for 12 games after sexist remarks about a female referee
item.description: SAO PAULO (AP) — A Brazilian sports court said on Thursday it suspended a defender of top-flight club Red Bull Bragantino for 12 matches because of sexist remarks he made about a female referee after a Sao Paulo state league game.

item.title: Poilievre says he has reservations about Carney's suggested fiscal watchdog
item.description: OTTAWA — Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre said he has "serious" reservations about Prime Minister Mark Carney's suggestion for a new parliamentary budget officer and is calling for the latest interim watchdog to get the job.
